response.passage: In the bustling corner of Gandhi Market, Mr. Sharma operates a popular street food stall known for his spicy aloo tikkis. He has been serving hungry customers at this exact spot for 12 years, starting his business long before the nearby Metro station was built. Every morning, he arrives at 6:00 AM to prepare his fresh potato mixture. The stall is always crowded because the aroma of frying spices drifts down the narrow lane, pulling people in from the main road. His assistant, young Rahul, helps by serving plates while Mr. Sharma focuses on the frying pan. Recently, a food blogger named Anjali visited the stall and praised the crispiness of the tikkis. She noted that the stall is successful because the high heat of the iron griddle ensures the potatoes cook perfectly without absorbing too much oil. Mr. Sharma believes that his secret recipe, passed down from his grandmother, is the true reason for his fame. Despite the competition from a new burger joint that opened 4 months ago, the stall remains a local favorite for office workers and students alike.
response.summary: Mr. Sharma runs a successful street food stall in Gandhi Market that has been popular for over a decade. His success is driven by his secret recipe and the specific cooking techniques he uses to prepare his tikkis.
